I'm passionate about helping tired parents combine developmental knowledge with their intuition to improve family sleep. My specialty is holistic, responsive sleep support for babies, toddlers, and nursing families.

feeds.title: The Sleep Lady Blog
feeds.description: The Sleep Lady is a brand, founded by Kim West, focusing on gentle sleep and parenting solutions. For over 25 years, we have helped hundreds of thousands of families get the rest they need, without leaving their children alone to cry it out. While we focus on sleep-training, we provide resources and tips for parents to help schedule their child's day, feedings and more.

feeds.title: Baby Sleep Love Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Rosalee Lahaie Hera & I'm a Certified Sleep Consultant who has been in your sleep-deprived shoes. My experience with a sleepless baby & the transformation I felt after I finally got some help - is what led me to start Baby Sleep Love. Baby Sleep Love helps families get more sleep, using gentle, intuitive & evidence-based methods. Read my blog for sleep tips for managing your baby, toddler, and preschooler sleep training.

feeds.title: Baby's Best Sleep
feeds.description: At Baby's Best Sleep, we're passionate about mental health, for you and your baby - and we know that when your baby doesn't sleep, everyone struggles. That's why we're passionate about helping families create sleep solutions that work for the entire family. Amanda is a real-talk mom and sleep consultant who wants YOU to know that you are not alone. Join others mom in child-related talks by clicking here!

feeds.title: Baby Sleep Consultant
